SASBDB entry SASDRR8  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDRR8/)

Chloroplast FOF1-ATP synthase (6FKF) in tPCC-alpha-M detergent
Publication DOI: 10.3390/ijms241310720
The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder. The paper was consulted only for SASDRR8
(Europe PMC); the others were unreachable, so their buffer, temperature and wavelength are
the SASBDB entry's (see the header of test/fitting_tests/SASDRR8/SASDRR8_fit2.jl).

Files: SASDRR8_fit2_model1.pdb (SASBDB's model, unmodified), SASDRR8_fit2.fit (depositor fit),
experimental_data/SASDRR8.dat. Reference: CRYSOL 1.347 (header Chi^2 1.347 = chi2; fit2 used, fit1 is 1.149).
Conditions: 20 °C (paper: room temperature), 0.154 nm.
Model: 39052 ATOM + 3 ATP, 3 ADP, 5 Mg (kept) + 25 waters (dropped) = 39204 heavy atoms.
